title: Cache Invalidation, Thundering Herd & Dogpiling
learningObjectives: Prevent Cache Stampedes (Dogpiling / Thundering Herd) using probabilistic early expiration (XFetch)
Implement distributed single-flight query coalescing and mutex locking
Design reliable cache invalidation patterns via event-driven pub/sub
keyTradeoffs: Serving stale data while background refresh completes vs blocking client threads on cache misses

commonPitfalls: Allowing 10,000 concurrent web requests to hit PostgreSQL at once when a homepage cache key expires
